name: La Palma de Cervelló (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the dark green palm frond of the arms set vertically.
history: The flag was approved on 7 September 2004 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the dark green palm of the arms, 5/6 of the height and 1/9 of the length, placed vertically at the centre.

features.role: palm frond set vertically, 5/6 of the height
